data: Does the trend of the curve for T=0.1 show an increase in Oracle CIDEr as Self-CIDEr increases?

The trend of the curve for T=0.1 shows an increase in Oracle CIDEr as Self-CIDEr increases. The red line represents T=0.1, and it is clearly visible that as the Self-CIDEr value increases, the corresponding Oracle CIDEr value also increases. This can be observed in the upper graph of the figure.
